brief.objective: Collect verifiable public evidence that can earn IPP v2 anchor points for this company. Each finding must cite a source URL and a verbatim excerpt.

rules: verified_fact requires evidence_url and confidence high|medium
an unknown must be recorded as information_gap_tbd, never guessed
one claim per finding; do not bundle

prohibited_inferences: Do not infer headcount, revenue, client names, rates, or contract terms from visual style or site size.
Do not convert a hypothesis into a verified fact because a completion target needs it.
Do not report a price range as the company's rate; directory estimates must be labelled as such, with dates.
Do not claim a decision-maker's receptiveness from a generic contact page.
Do not fabricate a case study, testimonial, or client logo that is not published.

anchors.attainment: verified active commercial pipeline (quarterly case studies, enterprise client roster, public hiring or client intake signals)
strong evidence of ongoing corporate/B2B customers and multiple projects (continuous stream of verified case studies or recognized brands)
ongoing corporate/B2B client work across multiple verifiable projects (continuous stream or recognized brands)
multiple identifiable real clients (rubric example: 3-5 verifiable commercial client case studies published within the last 12-18 months)
a few limited or weakly attributable client examples (rubric example: 1-2 projects)
documented continuous demand for custom backend/logic work coupled with verifiable technical delivery bottlenecks or capacity constraints
complex or repeated technical work (portals, dashboards, data sync, headless CMS, API middleware, platform migrations)
projects involving third-party APIs, external databases, member authentication or custom JavaScript/React application logic
occasional simple custom code (snippets, embed widgets, form webhooks, CSS overrides)
stable recurring commercial model (dedicated retainers, continuous platform evolution) across the primary client base
verified long-term contracts, recurring monthly retainers or multi-year rollout agreements with corporate clients
ongoing maintenance, feature iteration or continuous development documented for a subset of clients
occasional post-delivery support, warranty periods or sporadic maintenance requests
strong technical overlap (Webflow/Framer + backend, APIs, databases or React) plus documented, standardized development workflows
verified Webflow/Framer development combined with documented needs for backend architecture, custom APIs, external databases or bespoke React components
some overlap: standard Webflow or Framer builds with occasional external API requests
limited compatibility: visual-builder delivery (closed ecosystem, rare custom code)

anchors.rubric_lines: mid-sized studio inside the core sweet spot (10-24 people)
established studio across the upper sweet spot (25-50 people)

anchors.attainment: verifiable warm introduction, prior direct relationship or confirmed prior positive interaction
direct personal route to the decision-maker (verified personal email or active LinkedIn/InMail channel)
valid company-level channel (official inquiry/partnership inbox or contact form)
relevant founder/executive identified by name and role, without a direct channel
explicitly verified acceptance of a white-label/wholesale partnership model
premium positioning plus explicit evidence of engaging external software developers/engineering contractors
premium market positioning with documented premium budget indicators (e.g. $20k-$25k+ minimums or $100-$150+/hr rates)
limited commercial signal: standard B2B billing (e.g. $5k-$10k minimums) without premium cushion
